propositions: A not_a_bug close without --reason and without a replacement link incorrectly falls through to the completion verifier, which demands proof of a nonexistent defect fix and marks the close unmet.

not_a_bug and escalated lack deterministic dispositions when no replacement is present, so they must be made REASON_REQUIRED classes with optional replacement-link short-circuit (REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES).

not_a_bug and escalated require either a live replacement link OR a --reason attestation at write time; absence of both is refused by txn.close_class_refusal, never falling through to the completion verifier.

The fix adds not_a_bug and escalated to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES, creates REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES={not_a_bug,escalated} to preserve replacement-preferred precedence, and updates verdict() and reason_refusal logic to mint signed (class, reason) dispositions without LLM involvement.
